title: Lumexa Imaging Expands Partnership with Advocate Health Through New Illinois Joint Venture
summary: Lumexa Imaging (Nasdaq: LMRI), one of the nation’s largest outpatient imaging providers, today announced a new joint venture with Advocate Health to expand its outpatient imaging services in Illinois.
body_markdown:
*10th Health System joint venture expands Lumexa Imaging’s geographic footprint and advances its disciplined growth strategy*


**RALEIGH, N.C., – November 12, 2026 – Lumexa Imaging (Nasdaq: LMRI),** one of the nation’s largest outpatient imaging providers, today announced a new joint venture with Advocate Health to expand its outpatient imaging services in Illinois. The agreement builds on the existing partnership and marks Lumexa Imaging’s entry into Illinois.


With this agreement, Lumexa Imaging now has 10 joint ventures with 9 health systems, reflecting continued execution of its strategy to expand its presence in attractive healthcare markets and bring high-quality, convenient care closer to patients and referring providers.


“Expanding our relationship with Advocate Health into Illinois is an important milestone for our company,” said Caitlin Zulla, Chief Executive Officer of Lumexa Imaging. “Our demonstrated success partnering with health systems is a key differentiator as health systems look to expand their outpatient imaging capabilities and participate in the shift toward lower-cost settings. We look forward to bringing our clinical and operational expertise to Illinois as we establish our presence in this new geography.”


The new Illinois joint venture advances Lumexa Imaging’s disciplined geographic expansion strategy, which includes health system partnerships, de novo development, and acquisitions. The company remains focused on deploying capital efficiently in markets where it sees opportunities for sustainable, long-term growth.


**About Lumexa Imaging**


Lumexa Imaging is a nationwide provider of outpatient medical imaging. With over 5,000 team members and approximately 190 outpatient imaging centers, our team conducted approximately 4 million outpatient procedures system-wide in 2025. We are a partner of choice for health systems and radiologists, delivering best-in-class clinical excellence, operations, and state-of-the-art technology across our platform.
